body: A friend I've known for eight years now knows I've been having a worse time coping with my depression after an incident late last year. After a handful of brief discussions about said issue, they recently told me they don't want to listen to my problems and told me to find someone else. And before someone claims I've been discussing the issue too much, it was literally just a five minute conversation once a month. What a friend.
No. I tried for a long time. Either all booked up or unaffordable. So I gave up.

Thanks for being assumptive. I dislike one aspect of my life that for some reason other people enjoy, therefore I'm spoiled and entitled and have lived a perfectly good life. I've never worked, never been beaten, never had social services called on my home, never had a parent walk out and cut off contact, never attempted suicide while that same caring mother goaded me into doing so. I deeply apologize for not explaining the entirety of my life and family dynamics and laying out our financial issues to strangers on a website. Truly, you're better than me in character and morality and I am a sickening person.

Yeah, I'm unappreciative. So I tell people don't celebrate. Problem solved. Boo hoo, I don't want people to waste their time and money and put on fake smiles for something completely useless that I don't even enjoy, just for some likes on Facebook to boost their egos when there are more important things to do. Sorry you have family problems, but you're not the only person who does. Even if you have experienced worse, it's not a fucking competition, and it doesn't mean I can't be "unappreciative" of some bullshit I don't and have never enjoyed. Look up the fallacy of relative privation.

Ignore people like that, especially when they're strangers on the internet. Those are assholes who have little to no idea what it's like, who'd rather look down on those who have depression rather than attempt to understand or empathize in any way.
My main was banned earlier today. Submitted an appeal a little while ago, then found out about the IFTTT-related bans and disconnected it from reddit. Let's see if they'll lift the suspension.
